name: reading-keels-user-global-state-is-not-refused
description: T231 is about WRITES: a read of the same file by the same shell is not refused, so the board, the doctor and a curious session can all still look. This project carries NO ledger on purpose - the allow therefore comes from the read-only allowlist, and a regression that turned this rule into a blanket ban on naming the directory would show up here as a block rather than as silence.
